description: This source file defines the EncryptionImpl class which implements encryption and decryption methods using AES algorithm in Java. It includes methods for encrypting and decrypting strings, along with helper functions for converting between byte arrays and hexadecimal strings.

classes.name: EncryptionImpl
classes.description: A class providing AES encryption and decryption functionality implementing the Encryption interface.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a given string value using AES in CBC mode with PKCS5Padding.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted string back to its original form.

methods.name: bytesToHex
methods.description: Converts a byte array to its hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: hexToBytes
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string to its byte array form.

methods.name: getSecretKey
methods.description: Returns the current secret key used for encryption.

methods.name: setSecretKey
methods.description: Sets the secret key used for encryption.
